_comment: Reef hardware facts. Every entry carries value, units, source and confirmed. value null = still unknown; run_all.py fills measured values into results/results.json, never into this file.

clock_mhz.source: physical design team: SRAM timing closes at 50 MHz

dtcm_bytes.source: physical design team (2048 x 128-bit); coralnpu README

dtcm_banks.units: banks of 8 KB, selected by addr[10:9] (contiguous, not interleaved)

dbus_bytes_per_cycle.source: physical design team: 128-bit LSU<->DTCM, 1 access/cycle, pipelined, read data next cycle, writes same cycle, no backpressure, core wins arbiter

host_dma.source: physical design team: no DMA on this chip version; host writes DTCM through axi_slave in cycles the core leaves free

ebus_latency.source: physical design team: variable, tens of cycles (ebus -> AXI -> crossbar -> device)

axi_slave_data_bits.source: coralnpu RTL: VmeCoreMiniAxi gen flag --lsuDataBits=128 (hdl/chisel/src/coralnpu/flags.bzl:20); axi_slave width = axi2DataBits = lsuDataBits (CoreAxi.scala:31, Parameters.scala:187)

host_to_dtcm_bytes_per_cycle.source: to measure: sim ubench_axi_write. RTL upper bound 16 B/cycle (128-bit axi_slave, one beat per cycle) and only in cycles the core leaves DTCM free

vme_cycles_per_matmul_step.source: to measure: sim matmul_vme k sweep slope

sim.value: google-coral/coralnpu, cocotb + Verilator, hdl_toplevel VmeCoreMiniAxi, behavioral SRAM model
sim.source: coralnpu main: the experimental RTL with a working matrix unit. Its Verilator flow has only the behavioral SRAM model (no sram22 macro option)
